newsitem.title: UK: OPEC basket price rose 33 cts to $17.90 last week.
newsitem.headline: OPEC basket price rose 33 cts to $17.90 last week.

text.p: The price of OPEC's basket of seven crudes rose to $17.90 per barrel last week from $17.57 the previous week, the OPEC news agency OPECNA said on Monday.
Quoting figures released by the OPEC Secretariat, it said the price so far this year, up to May 1, has averaged $19.80 a barrel.
In April the basket price averaged $17.46, down from $18.64 in March and from $20.48 in February, it said.
For the first quarter of 1997, the basket price averaged $20.77 a barrel, against $23.06 in the fourth quarter of last year.
The basket comprises Algeria's Saharan Blend, Indonesia's Minas, Nigeria's Bonny Light, Saudi Arabia's Arabian Light, Dubai of the UAE, Venezuela's Tia Juana and Mexico's Isthmus.
